knowledge:
- key_parameters: transformationMethod=Specifies the count transformation method in exploreDDS, supporting "rlog", "vst", or "raw" ;; preFilter=Optional filtering of low-count genes before transformation in exploreDDS and exploreDDSplot ;; samples=A character vector of sample names to compare in exploreDDSplot ;; scattermatrix=Logical value to enable a scatterplot matrix in exploreDDSplot ;; method=Correlation method used in hclustplot (e.g., "spearman") ;; clust=Clustering target in heatMaplot, either "samples" or "ind" ;; plotly=Logical value to generate interactive HTML plots in heatMaplot, PCAplot, MDSplot, and GLMplot ;; DEGlist=Character vector of differentially expressed gene IDs required when clust="ind" in heatMaplot ;; comparison=The pairwise comparison name to plot in MAplot and volcanoplot ;; filter=Named numeric vector specifying Fold and FDR thresholds (e.g., c(Fold = 1, FDR = 20)) in MAplot and volcanoplot ;; genes=Character vector of specific gene IDs to highlight in MAplot and volcanoplot ;; perplexity=Perplexity parameter for t-SNE dimensionality reduction in tSNEplot
- alternatives: DESeq2 package functions (vst, rlog) can be used directly for complex experimental designs instead of the exploreDDS wrapper. Custom visualization alternatives can be integrated due to the modular design of systemPipeR.
- when_to_use: Use this package during the exploratory data analysis (EDA), quality control, and differential expression visualization phases of an RNA-seq transcriptomics workflow.
- pitfalls: The input count matrix for exploreDDS must contain all genes, not just differentially expressed ones. GLMplot requires raw count data transformed with transformationMethod="raw", whereas other dimensionality reduction plots (PCA, MDS) require normalized/transformed data (rlog or vst). When setting clust="ind" in heatMaplot, you must provide a valid DEGlist or the function will fail.

workflows.name: rna_seq_exploration_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Perform exploratory data analysis, dimensionality reduction, clustering, and differential expression visualization on RNA-seq count data.
workflows.stages: 1. Load metadata and raw count matrix ;; 2. Transform raw counts using exploreDDS ;; 3. Visualize transformation effects with exploreDDSplot ;; 4. Perform hierarchical clustering with hclustplot and heatMaplot ;; 5. Perform dimensionality reduction using PCAplot, MDSplot, GLMplot, and tSNEplot ;; 6. Run differential expression analysis and visualize results using MAplot and volcanoplot
workflows.code:
targetspath <- system.file("extdata", "targets.txt", package = "systemPipeR")
targets <- read.delim(targetspath, comment = "#")
cmp <- systemPipeR::readComp(file = targetspath, format = "matrix", delim = "-")
countMatrixPath <- system.file("extdata", "countDFeByg.xls", package = "systemPipeR")
countMatrix <- read.delim(countMatrixPath, row.names = 1)
showDT(countMatrix)
exploredds <- exploreDDS(countMatrix, targets, cmp = cmp[[1]], preFilter = NULL, transformationMethod = "rlog")
exploredds
exploreDDSplot(countMatrix, targets, cmp = cmp[[1]], preFilter = NULL, samples = c("M12A", "M12A", "A12A", "A12A"), scattermatrix = TRUE)
hclustplot(exploredds, method = "spearman")
heatMaplot(exploredds, clust = "samples", plotly = FALSE)
degseqDF <- systemPipeR::run_DESeq2(countDF = countMatrix, targets = targets, cmp = cmp[[1]], independent = FALSE)
DEG_list <- systemPipeR::filterDEGs(degDF = degseqDF, filter = c(Fold = 2, FDR = 10))
heatMaplot(exploredds, clust = "ind", DEGlist = unique(as.character(unlist(DEG_list[[1]]))))
PCAplot(exploredds, plotly = FALSE)
MDSplot(exploredds, plotly = FALSE)
exploredds_r <- exploreDDS(countMatrix, targets, cmp = cmp[[1]], preFilter = NULL, transformationMethod = "raw")
GLMplot(exploredds_r, plotly = FALSE)
MAplot(degseqDF, comparison = "M12-A12", filter = c(Fold = 1, FDR = 20), genes = "ATCG00280")
tSNEplot(countMatrix, targets, perplexity = 5)
volcanoplot(degseqDF, comparison = "M12-A12", filter = c(Fold = 1, FDR = 20), genes = "ATCG00280")
